invariants.description: inv_Delta_Es = s + (1e-7 - s) exp(-t/tau_Es), s = -inv_G_Es ln(f_esh - f_es_min + 1) (INV law)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(inv_Delta_Es - ((-inv_G_Es*np.log(f_esh - f_es_min + 1) if f_esh >= f_es_min else 0.0) + (1e-7 - (-inv_G_Es*np.log(f_esh - f_es_min + 1) if f_esh >= f_es_min else 0.0))*np.exp(-t/tau_Es)))) <= 2e-2*np.max(np.abs(inv_Delta_Es))

bc_sweep.rationale: only the inputs are swept: inv_Delta_* cross zero (1/0 singularity in Delta_Emax) for other signs/sizes of the gains, which is a fragility of the compliance form.

baseline.reason: superseded ("OLD") variant; owner to decide whether to delete it. Exact solution used for verification.
